# Purpose
The BCG calculator requires the inclusion of Index Name and Index Class fields 
in the input file (otherwise the R code won’t know which BCG rules to apply). 

There is a new statewide BCG model for Oregon and Washington that supersedes the
previous Pacific Northwest Maritime Region (PNMR) model, which only covered the
western ecoregions.

The statewide classification scheme is based on Omernik Level 4 ecoregion, 
NHDPlus v2 slope and collection method (targeted riffle or random transect).

Columns with Index_Name and Index_Class must be included in the input file (they
tell the R code which rules to apply to each sample).

Index_Name = BCG_ORWA_v1_Bugs500ct

Index_Class entries must match one of the options below:

|INDEX_CLASS              |
|-------------------------|
|Foothills_Multihab       |
|Foothills_Riffle         |
|Lowlands_Multihab_HiGrad |
||Lowlands_Multihab_LoGrad|
|Lowlands_Riffle          |
|MountainCold_Multihab    |
|MountainCold_Riffle      |
|NBR_Riffle               |
|Xeric_Multihab           |
|Xeric_Riffle             |
  
When assigning samples to Index_Class:

*	Foothills, Lowlands, MountainCold, Northern Basin and Range (NBR) and Xeric 
are based on which Omernik Level 4 ecoregion the site is located in. Download
translator sheet [here](links/ORWA_Statewide_BCGclasses_20260706.xlsx).

* Collection method (Multihab vs. Riffle) is self-explanatory

    +	Riffle = targeted riffle method used by ORDEQ, King and Snohomish County and others

    +	Multihab = random transect method used by WA_ECY

*	Gradient (which is only used for the Lowlands_Multihab classes) is based on NHDPlus v2 percent slope

    +	LoGrad (low gradient) < 1%

    +	HiGrad (high gradient) >= 1%

If you prefer to use the old Pacific Northwest Maritime Region (PNMR) model, 
there are two versions:

*	Index_Name = BCG_MariNW_v2_Bugs500ct

*	Index_Name = BCG_MariNW_Bugs500ct

They are the same EXCEPT we removed the Level 6 rule for number of total 
individuals from the BCG_MariNW_v2_Bugs500ct model, since that rule was causing
samples to be bumped to Level 6 that the BCG workgroup thought were better 
suited to BCG level 5.

Index_Class entries for either PNMR model must match one of the options below:

|INDEX_CLASS  |
|-------------|
|HiGrad-LoElev|
|HiGrad-HiElev|
|LoGrad-LoElev|
 
The classification thresholds are 1% for gradient (NHDPlus v2 percent slope) and
750-m for elevation.
